Watts made this hymn from Psalm 2, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain? 2The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One: 3“Let us break Their chains and cast away Their cords.” 4The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord taunts them. … 8 more verses PSALM 2 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 2
